name: GTA VI - Cheat Pack by deFIATer/czupryneq

mods.name: Unlimited Health
mods.description: Prevents nonlethal health loss.

mods.name: Unlimited Stamina
mods.description: Prevents stamina drain.

mods.name: Max Relationship
mods.description: Sets the relationship score to its maximum.

mods.name: Clear Wanted Level
mods.description: Clears the current wanted level.

mods.name: Infinite Ammo
mods.description: Prevents ammo use when firing.

mods.name: Max Criminal Profile
mods.description: Sets your profile to Professional.

mods.name: Time: Morning (08:00)
mods.description: Locks in-game clock to 08:00 (toggle OFF to resume clock; enable one PLT cheat at a time).

mods.name: Time: Noon (12:00)
mods.description: Locks in-game clock to 12:00 (toggle OFF to resume clock; enable one PLT cheat at a time).

mods.name: Time: Sunset (19:00)
mods.description: Locks in-game clock to 19:00 (toggle OFF to resume clock; enable one PLT cheat at a time).

mods.name: Time: Midnight (00:00)
mods.description: Locks in-game clock to 00:00 (toggle OFF to resume clock; enable one PLT cheat at a time).

mods.name: Vehicle Auto-Repair
mods.description: Continuously repairs your current vehicle (enable one PLT cheat at a time).
